name: admin-webapp

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: Product/inventory CRUD, image management, order list/detail, and order-status update calls (admin endpoints).

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Staff sign-in; only callers in the Store Admin/Staff group are authorized by ceramics-api's admin endpoints.

description: Staff-only React SPA admin console: product & inventory management (including stocked-vs-unique flag, variants, images) and order management (list, detail, status updates with restocking on cancellation). Exposed only to the org intranet. Calls ceramics-api for all data and signs staff in via the shared user-auth Thunder dependency.
